_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro:
Iwe ndiwe Mchezaji {player_id} michezo ya Liar's Dice ya {num_players}.
Miongozo:
- Pa zamu yako, unaweza kuchagua:
  1) Utekelezwe kubai kwa wingi mwingi kana kwa uso mwingi (kana zote mbiri) kuliko kubai kwakati hiki; yaani '[Bid: 3, 4]',
  2) Ite simu ya kubai la mwisho kwa kuandika '[Call]'.

Ukaita simu:
  - Ikiwa kuhesabiwa kwakweli kwa thamani ya uso huo kati ya mabai yote ni chini ya kubai, mchezaji wa mwisho wa kubai anapoteza bai moja.
  - Vinginevyo, maiti anapoteza bai moja.
Mchezaji anayefikia 0 bai anatolewa. Mchezaji wa mwisho anayesalia anashinda.

board.new_round:
Mwaka mitsva - Tsvimbo dzerudo: {dice_summary}
Tsvimbo dzauno dziri kuna: {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses:
Mchezaji {current_player_id} anaita simu! Kuhesabiwa kwakweli kwa uso {face_value} ni {count}, ambayo ni CHINI ya {quantity}.
Mchezaji {loser_id} (mchezaji wa mwisho wa kubai) anapoteza bai moja.
call.caller_loses:
Mchezaji {current_player_id} anaita simu! Kuhesabiwa kwakweli kwa uso {face_value} ni {count}, ambayo ni >= {quantity}.
Mchezaji {loser_id} (maiti) anapoteza bai moja.

invalid_move.not_recognized: Shanda harikwanisi kuzivikanwa kana '[Bid: X, Y]' kana '[Call]' chete. Shanda rakapihwa: {action}

bid_reason.face_lower: Mutengo mutsva wezita {new_face_value} wakaderera pane uripo iye zvino {current_face_value}.
bid_reason.face_range: Kukosha kunofanira kuva pakati pe1 ne6.
